Reactor becomes a dark ruptured cavity with cracked original housing and a few dim amber traces, no intact glowing orange glass.
Output one complete original fortress with ALL THREE modules in destroyed state so game can replace their regions independently. Everything else must remain pixel-registered: same exact main nose, wings, upward tail, fuselage, red vents and panel lines. Absolutely no flying fragments, falling debris, free metal chunks, smoke, fire, projectiles, rings or glow aura. True transparent background. Same framing and padding as input, no labels/text/watermark or extra objects.

ONE square true-transparent sprite sheet, EXACTLY 4 columns x 4 rows =16 equal cells, sequence left-to-right top-to-bottom. Same centered origin, no labels/grid/background/checkerboard. 12% empty margins in every cell, no crossing between cells.
